What's new in 0.1.72:
• Choose how updates work: ask me, download automatically, or download and install automatically (waits until nobody is watching, then reopens Beebo).
• Live TV: add your own playlist from your own provider (Beta, tested with test servers only).
• Folders on a NAS or any folder you cannot write to now work.
• Optional: start Beebo with Windows, before you sign in (Beta, off by default).
• Wake your sleeping PC from the Android app at home.
• Campsite wireless speakers screen (In development).
